evidence.quoted_text: exec(compile(data, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)  # noqa: S102 - bound bytes
evidence.reason: The helper load boundary compiles the helper bytes without catching SyntaxError, unlike the adjacent live-binding loader which translates SyntaxError to Refused. In --json machine mode the uncontracted traceback goes to stderr and no JSON error reaches stdout, contradicting the current I1 contract that machine-mode stderr stays empty and an error with no result writes an { error: … } object to stdout. The fix is a narrow translation at the helper-load boundary, preserving the existing hash check and executing only the hashed bytes.
